faq.question: Is Birdcast available in Business Bay?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast has a Business Bay studio suitable for podcasts, interviews, founder content and branded conversations.

faq.question: Who is the Business Bay studio best for?
faq.answer: It works well for founders, executives, consultants, guests and teams who want a central Dubai studio close to key business areas.

faq.question: Can I record short clips during a podcast session?
faq.answer: Yes. If this is planned in advance, a podcast session can also support short-form clips depending on the setup and timing.

faq.question: Can I book the Business Bay studio online?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the booking button to select the date and time that works for your Business Bay session.

faq.question: Can I discuss the studio before booking?
faq.answer: Yes. Message Birdcast on WhatsApp if you want to discuss the format, set, guests or visit before booking.
